title: [Deprecated] Microsoft Entra ID Assets
descriptionMarkdown:
**This connector is deprecated.** The replacement, **Microsoft Entra ID Assets (Preview)**, collects asset and relationship data into your **Azure Log Analytics workspace**, shifting collection from the legacy data-lake integration to workspace-based ingestion and querying. Existing connections and historical data are not migrated automatically. Configure and validate the replacement, review affected queries and downstream dependencies, and assess Log Analytics ingestion and retention charges before disconnecting this connector. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Microsoft%20Entra%20ID%20Assets/README.md#migrate-from-the-legacy-connector). The replacement is preview; confirm its suitability for your use case before migrating.

Entra ID assets data connector gives richer insights into activity data by supplementing details with asset information. Data from this connector is used to build data risk graphs in Purview. If you have enabled those graphs, deactivating this Connector will prevent the graphs from being built. [Learn about the data risk graph.](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2320023)

parameters.description: 1. Connect Microsoft Entra ID assets to ingest into Microsoft Sentinel Lake.
